rationale: The visible producer report and evidence support the conservative boundary. The meta-analysis extraction records downstream_gate_status=closed, oral_ready_gate_status=closed, ce_selection_gate_passed=false, and model_family_gate_met=false, while only large_eval and seed robustness passed. The oral-ready gate evidence explicitly says status is closed and forbids venue-readiness, downstream utility, and pretrained-reference superiority claims; the report evidence also lists downstream, model-family, CE-selection, and oral gates as closed or failed. These closed gates support describing Stage10 as a closed-gate evidence package rather than an overclaimed venue-ready, downstream-useful, pretrained-reference-superior, or universal recovery result.
